label: Countable and uncountable nouns
outcome: Lo studente riconosce e usa i nomi countable e uncountable più frequenti, gestendo singolare/plurale, a/an, numeri, accordo e semplici unità/contenitori senza trasferire automaticamente la numerabilità dall'italiano.
must_master: recognise common countable versus uncountable nouns
avoid a/an and ordinary plural -s with common uncountable nouns

scope_boundary.quantifiers: Some/any and much/many/a lot of have dedicated Recovery topics. Use them only as supporting evidence of countability, not as the main lesson.
scope_boundary.advanced_mass_count_shifts: Do not systematically teach advanced count/mass meaning shifts; allow only common contextual uses such as two coffees in a café.
scope_boundary.units: Teach only high-frequency natural units such as bottle of water and piece of advice.
scope_boundary.lexis: Keep nouns familiar; difficulty must come from countability decisions.

quality_rejections: mechanical noun-list classification for most of the lesson
teaching all quantifiers inside this topic
marking common serving uses such as two coffees as always wrong
rare food vocabulary used to create difficulty
more than two consecutive countable/uncountable label questions
accepting informations, advices or homeworks as standard target forms
